summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases, added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and created tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. Two open points: I did not add tests for the non-callable assertion, empty keys, or the iterable-callable case, and I chose copy.copy over dict() for the Lambdad shallow copy to preserve the mapping type.
